q: The manner in which on-costs are levied on workshop jobs is as:

options.A: 50%, the higher of the two rates

q: Shop on-cost represents:

q: General on-cost represents:

options.D: Indirect expenditure common to all shops in the workshop

options.B: Shop on-cost of a single shop

q: Pro-forma on-cost comprises:

options.C: Proportionate supervisory services, interest and depreciation, and pensionary equivalents

q: A private party gets a component manufactured in a railway workshop. The administrative charges recovered from the party are called:
Pro-forma on-cost charges realised from outside parties for works done in railway workshops form part of:

options.A: Rs. 1 lakh, proportionate to the progress

options.A: A is true, but R is false.
